title: On the Inactive tab a row click ticks the row in bulk mode only
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have three inactive parts, part A, part B and part C.
  • Give parts A, B and C part numbers that start with the same text, so one search lists all three.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Inactive tab.
custom_steps:
1. Type the shared start of the part numbers in the Search box.
  2. Click the part A row.
  3. Click Cancel.
  4. Click the three-dot actions button (⋮) in the toolbar, to the left of New Inventory Part.
  5. Click Activate parts.
  6. Click the part A row.
  7. Click the part A row again.
  8. Click the checkbox in the header row.
  9. Click the checkbox in the header row again.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Parts A, B and C are listed, with no checkbox column.

Step 2:

  • With bulk mode off, the row click opens Edit Inventory Part for part A.

Step 3:

  • The window closes without changes.

Step 4:

  • The menu opens.

Step 5:

  • The checkbox column and the dark bar appear; the bar reads 0 selected, with a blue "Activate" button.

Step 6:

  • The part A row is ticked (1 selected) and no window opens.

Step 7:

  • The part A row is unticked (0 selected).

Step 8:

  • All 3 loaded rows are ticked (3 selected).

Step 9:

  • All ticks are cleared (0 selected).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10816 (Story 3, Activate Parts in Bulk), story SV-10815 (Story 2, Deactivate Parts in Bulk)

  • S3-R3: “S2-R3 to S2-R10b, S2-R14 to S2-R17 and S2-N3 apply on the Inactive tab exactly as on the Active tab, with "deactivate" read as "activate". The disabled button's hover text is "Tick the parts to activate".”
  • S2-R3: “Outside the mode the Inventory list has no checkbox column, and a row click opens the part.”
  • S2-R5: “While the mode is on, a click anywhere on a row ticks or unticks that row instead of opening the part.”
  • S2-R6: “The checkbox in the header ticks or clears every row loaded in the list. The list loads 30 parts at a time as the user scrolls, so it ticks only the rows loaded so far. The count in the bar shows exactly how many parts will change.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
